app.title: NIHCC Chest X-ray Image Search Local RAG
app.brandTitle: Chest X-ray Image Search Local RAG
banner.research: For research, education, and technical validation only. The labels shown are labels bundled with the dataset (weak, image-level labels extracted automatically from radiology reports), not confirmed diagnoses. Search results indicate similarity only and do not show the presence, severity, or cause of any disease.

search.dropzone: Drag and drop a PNG / JPEG, or click to choose one
search.textPlaceholder: e.g. pulmonary nodule in the right upper lung field / 右上肺野の結節影
search.textLanguage.ja: Japanese (translated to English with the approved local dictionary)
search.optRerankTitle: Strictly re-orders the first-stage candidates (approximate appearance embedding) using the second-stage finding profile (chest-region classifier). Without a configured classifier, and for searches that include text, a single-stage search is used (see models.rerank in the response).
search.needImage: This mode requires a query image.
results.empty: No search has been run yet.
results.heading: Results
results.estimateTitle: Probabilities from a classifier trained on chest-region images. This is not a diagnosis. It is separate from the dataset labels (derived from radiology reports by NLP).
results.estimateHeading: Estimated findings (research use, not a diagnosis)
results.queryChestAlt: Chest region of the query image
results.labelSource: Label source: {source} (bundled with the dataset, image level)
results.rerank.profileTitle: Ranked by exact comparison against the finding profiles of all images (no BiomedCLIP candidate narrowing)
results.rerank.stage1Title: {reranked} of {stage1} stage-1 candidates were re-scored by finding profile
results.queryLungAlt: Lung field outline of the query image
results.lungCaption: The yellow line is the lung field outline used for comparison
results.lungQueryNote: Cases are listed to the right, closest shape first.
results.chestHeading: Cases with a similar chest region
results.chestNote: Ranked by comparing chest regions (inside the orange line), including the lung fields, mediastinum, and diaphragm. The leftmost card is the query.
results.labelNote: "Dataset labels" are image-level labels derived from radiology reports by NLP. "Estimated findings" are probabilities from a classifier trained on chest-region images and are not a diagnosis. The two are separate.
results.noCandidates: No matching candidates (including results suppressed because the query's chest region confidence was too low).
results.lungHeading: Cases with a similar thorax shape
results.lungNote: Ordered by similarity of the overall lung field outline, left-right symmetry, and mediastinal width (image level). This does not identify findings. It is an axis for comparing cases with a similar build or similar imaging appearance side by side.
results.lungEmpty: No lung shape vectors have been registered yet.
results.lungFailed: Could not retrieve candidates by thorax shape.

server.USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: This account name is already in use.
server.LAST_ADMIN_PROTECTED: This change would leave no active administrators. Set up another administrator first.
server.LAST_ADMIN_DELETE_PROTECTED: The last administrator account cannot be deleted. Set up another administrator first.
server.NO_FIELDS_TO_UPDATE: There are no fields to update.
server.SELF_DELETE_FORBIDDEN: You cannot delete your own account.
server.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password is the same as the current password.
server.PASSWORD_POLICY_VIOLATION: Enter a password of {min} to {max} characters.
server.PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The confirmation password does not match.
server.RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: This URL is invalid. Please start the password reset again.
server.RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This URL has expired (valid for {ttl} minutes). Please start the password reset again.
server.PASSWORD_CHANGED: Your password was changed. For security, please sign in again.
server.PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED: If the email address you entered is registered, a URL for resetting your password has been sent. The URL expires in {ttl} minutes.
server.PASSWORD_RESET_DONE: Your password was reset. Please sign in with the new password.
server.TEXT_NOT_TRANSLATABLE: Japanese free text could not be translated to English with the approved local dictionary. Enter English, or one of the registered standard findings.
server.FINDING_LABEL_UNKNOWN: Could not resolve the finding names: {unresolved}. Allowed values: {allowed} (Japanese names are also accepted).
server.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image exceeds the size limit.
server.IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Only PNG and JPEG images are accepted.
server.IMAGE_DECODE_FAILED: The image could not be decoded.
server.IMAGE_MIME_MISMATCH: The image format does not match the file content.
server.ROI_EXTRACTION_FAILED: Could not extract the chest region from the query image: {reason}
server.LUNG_TOO_SMALL: Could not extract the chest region from the query image (the lung fields are too small).
server.LUNG_NOT_FOUND: Could not extract the chest region from the query image (no lung fields were found).
server.REJECTED_VIEW: Specify a grayscale frontal chest image.
server.IMAGE_FLAT: The image has no contrast, so the chest region cannot be extracted.
server.BODY_NOT_FOUND: Could not estimate the body region in the query image.
server.THORAX_TOO_SMALL: The thorax region in the query image is too small.
server.SPINE_NOT_FOUND: Could not estimate the spine centre line in the query image.
server.PROFILE_NOT_UNET: The chest region extraction profile does not use a U-Net. Contact the operator.
server.RESEARCH_USE: For research use only. Search results and dataset labels do not indicate a diagnosis.
server.QUERY_ROI_UNCERTAIN: Chest region extraction for the query image is uncertain (e.g. one lung was not found, or the left-right difference is large). Treat the results as reference only.
server.RERANK_PARTIAL: Some candidates have no finding profile registered, so they are returned in their stage-1 order. Re-ingesting them resolves this.
server.RERANK_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE: Finding profiles are built from images, so re-ranking is not applied to searches that include text (it is applied to image-only searches).
server.SELF_MATCH_EXCLUDED: The same image as the query (same file name, similarity 1.0) is excluded from the results.
server.RERANK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The stage-1 search used up the timeout budget, so re-ranking was skipped. Review VECTOR_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS or VECTOR_STAGE1_MULTIPLIER.
server.RESULTS_SUPPRESSED_LOW_CONFIDENCE: Results were suppressed because the chest region confidence of the query image ({confidence}) is below the threshold ({threshold}).
